test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 19 June 2001 is Tuesday, then what will be the day of the week on 21 August 2009?
solution: Given: 19 June 2001 is **Tuesday**. Now, 2001 to 2009 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Year and 2 Leap Year). And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap years and 6 Ordinary Year. So, 2 Leap Year has 4 odd days, And, 6 Ordinary Year has 6 odd days. Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10. 10 odd days → 10/7 = 1 week and 3 odd days.
